basic_profile.bio: Enthusiast of all things related to flashlights and electronics, currently residing in Berlin. I spend my free time engaging in hands-on projects like rock tumbling and exploring the newest X-Men comics. Professionally, I work as an electronics technician, which feeds my passion for DIY projects and tinkering with gadgets. I’m usually active on Reddit during late evenings and weekends as I balance my job and social activities. Single, but I enjoy meeting new people, especially those who share my interests in niche hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in electronics obtained through a combination of formal education in electrical engineering and practical experience gained from my job as an electronics technician. This background allows me to contribute to discussions about flashlight modifications and other related DIY projects.
